contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes

tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)

    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)

vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.

throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()
    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1
    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# 1. Initialize the Chrono engine and create the physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Set gravity
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))

# 2. Create the terrain (rigid ground) with specified friction and restitution
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(50, 1, 50, 1000, True, True)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -0.5, 0))
ground.SetBodyFixed(True)
# Set material properties
material = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()
material.SetFriction(0.8)  # example friction coefficient
material.SetRestitution(0.1)  # example restitution coefficient
ground.GetCollisionModel().ClearModel()
ground.GetCollisionModel().AddBox(material, 25, 0.5, 25)
ground.GetCollisionModel().BuildModel()
ground.SetMaterialSurface(material)
system.Add(ground)

# 3. Create the UAZBUS vehicle
# Initialize the vehicle with default parameters
my_vehicle = veh.UAZBUS(vehicle_step_size=1e-3)

# Set initial position and orientation
initial_pos = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.5, 0)
initial_rot = chrono.Q_from_AngleAxis(0, chrono.ChVectorD(0, 1, 0))
my_vehicle.GetChassisBody().SetPos(initial_pos)
my_vehicle.GetChassisBody().SetRot(initial_rot)

# Add the vehicle to the system
system.Add(my_vehicle.GetChassisBody())

# 4. Initialize the driver system for vehicle control
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver()
driver.Initialize(system, my_vehicle.GetVehicle())

# 5. Set up the Irrlicht visualization
# Create the Irrlicht application
application = irr.ChIrrApp(system, 'UAZBUS Simulation', irr.dimension2du(800, 600))
application.AddTypicalLights()
application.AddTypicalCamera(irr.vector3df(0, 3, -10))
application.SetCameraMoveScale(0.1)
application.SetChaseCamera(my_vehicle.GetChassisBody(), 3.0, 0.5)

# Enable shadows and skybox for better visualization
application.SetShadows(true)
application.SetSkyBox()

# Bind the user interface
application.AssetBindAll()
application.AssetUpdateAll()

# 6. Simulation loop parameters
time_step = 1e-3
total_time = 20  # seconds
current_time = 0

# 7. Main simulation loop
while application.GetDevice().run():
    # Synchronize driver inputs
    driver.Synchronize(current_time)
    driver.Advance(time_step)

    # Synchronize vehicle with driver inputs
    my_vehicle.GetVehicle().GetChassis()->SetAppliedForce(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))  # optional: reset forces
    my_vehicle.GetVehicle().GetChassis()->SetAppliedTorque(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
    my_vehicle.GetVehicle().GetChassis()->SetInput(driver.GetSteering(), driver.GetThrottle(), driver.GetBraking())

    # Advance the system
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)

    # Update visualization
    application.AssetUpdateAll()

    # Advance simulation time
    current_time += time_step

    # Maintain real-time
    application.GetDevice().run()
    application.Synchronize('')  # optional: pass a string for window title updates
    application.Advance(time_step)

# End of simulation
application.GetDevice().close()
```

```python
        steering_input = 1.0  # full right turn
        throttle_input = 1.0  # full throttle
    # Lane change to the left between 2 and 4 seconds
    elif 2 <= current_time < 4:
        steering_input = -1.0  # full left turn
        throttle_input = 1.0
    # Straighten lane between 4 and 6 seconds
    elif 4 <= current_time < 6:
        steering_input = 0.0
        throttle_input = 1.0
    # Brake after 6 seconds
    elif current_time >= 6:
        steering_input = 0.0
        throttle_input = 0.0
        brake_input = 1.0  # full brake

    # Apply driver inputs
    driver.SetSteering(steering_input)
    driver.SetThrottle(throttle_input)
    driver.SetBraking(brake_input)

    # Increment step number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real-time synchronization
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
```
